name: Rasengan
description: A rotating sphere of concentrated chakra is shaped and held steady in a single open palm, using rotation instead of hand seals.

steps.instruction: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees soft.
Extend one arm forward, palm facing up, elbow slightly bent.
Cup the opposite hand briefly above the palm as if shaping a ball of energy.
Hold the palm steady and flat, fingers relaxed and slightly curled.
Keep the supporting arm tucked at your side for balance.
